messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

已查到可引用的部分資料：

To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI, we need formal R&S specifications/features for our products, not sales positioning alone [2][14][20].
We need official competitor documentation or third-party evidence, because current Amarisoft competitor claims are only from an R&S internal battle card [14].
For our signaling side, CMX500 support can be evidenced with formal product positioning and features such as NR FR1/FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, application test, IMS/audio/POLQA, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [6].
For non-signaling or production-side positioning, the Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing source supports CMX500 for R&D signaling/interworking and CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [24].
For AI-specific R&S evidence, the only supported AI claim here is that ScriptAssist is an AI-powered script generation tool for NTN-specific R&D protocol/application testing and instrument automation scripting [10].
Any claim that “only R&S,” “safe and future-proof,” or similar superiority language proves a technical advantage should not be used as a verified specification [14].
Any binding technical comparison should use specifications with limits, because the CMX500 features/functions document is an overview and data without tolerance limits is not binding [2].

來源：
[2] Wiki：R&S CMX500（來源：`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[6] Wiki：R&S CMX500（來源：`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[10] Wiki：CMX500 NTN one-box tester（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`…）
[14] Wiki：R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft（來源：`2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card.md`、`CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`…）
[20] Wiki：R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft（來源：`2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card.md`、`CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`…）
[24] Wiki：Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing（來源：`Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`）

passages.text:
CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing。
- 來源明示 supported technologies：[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、[[Direct-to-Cell]]（D2C / DTC）。
- 來源宣稱 users can test all NTN technologies on both network and device level without multiple instruments。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將於 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] booth 5A80 / hall 5 展示 upgraded one-box tester，活動期間為 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-05。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- Comprehensive support for NR-NTN。
- Multi-orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- Complete channel emulation in one box。
- Live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters。
- NB-NTN coming end of `25。
- Option 線索：[[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

此處的 one-box tester 是 PR / solution positioning 與簡報 use-case 語彙；正式 hardware configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 與 order number 仍需回 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]、[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]、[[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]] 與正式 configurator。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

passages.text:
R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

amarisoft › 與 R&S 產品的對比脈絡
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]，R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主要差異化論點為：

- [[R&S CMX500]]：one-box [[NR FR1]] + [[NR FR2]] + [[Wi-Fi signaling]]，並支援 validated testing。
- [[R&S CMW500]]：legacy 2G/3G continuity。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]：production / ATE / non-signaling scaling path。
- R&S：global support、multi-year warranties、calibration labs、service contracts。
- R&S：PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests；來源稱 [[amarisoft]] functional only，not accepted for operator certification。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 使用限制
- 本頁不建立 RFU18 的正式產品規格；目前來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、規格書文件編號、release date 或 supported configurations。
- **FR3** 的正式頻段定義、3GPP / 6G 標準版本、R&S option code 與 measurement bandwidth 仍缺正式標準 / 規格來源；目前 PR 說法為 proposed 7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz。
- Anritsu FR3 **0.4–16 GHz**、FR2 **43.5 GHz / 800 MHz / 5 Gbps** 等數字目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Anritsu 官方規格。
- Keysight UXM-P / RaySim / future hardware / software 的 FR3 / 6G path 目前只來自 R&S battle card，不能視為 Keysight 官方 roadmap。
- RFU18 up to **18 GHz** 同時出現在 battle card 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]；但 max aggregated NR bandwidth **2000 MHz** 目前仍只在 battle card 中出現。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 的 13 GHz demo 未提供 throughput、bandwidth、MCS index、MIMO layers、hardware configuration 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 的 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation demo 未提供 carrier bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software version、RFU18 detailed specs 或 measurement uncertainty；只能作為 PR / demonstration-level evidence。

passages.text:
CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 相關工具與 package
來源明示或描述下列工具 / package：

- [[Constellation Insight Tool]]：用於 real-time constellation visualization、mobility management、trajectory observation、digital twin of the live sky、automated deployment and handovers、ephemeris data integration 與 complex handover scenarios。
- [[XLAPI]] Python Test Case package：包含 Starlink [[LTE-DTC]] scenarios，例如 LTE attach time / success rates、Event A3 handover、cell reselection 與 RLF recovery。
- [[ScriptAssist]]：AI-powered script generation tool，用於加速 NTN-specific R&D protocol and application testing 以及 instrument automation 的 scripting。
- [[R&S CMX-KS627B]]：[[CMX500_Callbox]] 中列為 NR Signaling Extension Rel-17，用於 NTN slide 的 option 線索。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的差異
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 不直接消除上述 battle card 與 formal specs 的矛盾；它只提供 PR 層級的 13 GHz demonstration claim。[[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] 則提高了 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz 的可追溯性，但仍未提供 formal RFU18 specifications。

passages.text:
CMX500 NTN one-box tester › Conformance / carrier acceptance claim
來源宣稱：

- [[R&S CMX500]] is industry-leading in conformance testing。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] supports NTN conformance and carrier acceptance testing。
- 來源稱其 offering the highest number of validated test cases for [[NR-NTN]] according to [[3GPP Release 17]]。
- Validations were conducted across [[PCT]]、[[RF]] 與 [[RRM]] domains。

使用限制：來源未列 test case IDs、數量、validation date、validation body、test specification version、DUT 或比較對象。因此這些 statements 只能作為 PR claim，不可替代 conformance test package database 或 formal validation report。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強 [[5G NR SAR testing]]：既有頁以 [[SPEAG]] / [[DASY8-3D]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 SAR automation PR 為主；本來源從 CE RED Art 3.1a / FCC SAR / HAC compliance presentation 的角度補入 5G NR network emulator、multi-radio UE、average-SAR 與 CMW/CMX signaling solution。
- 補強 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]：既有頁只由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 支撐 TS9975 作為 UAV EMI system；本來源新增 wireless devices Art 3.1b EMC / ABT context，並與 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 同列。
- 連接 [[低軌衛星終端設備檢測]]與 [[衛星地球電臺設備技術規範]]：既有頁以台灣 111年08月衛星地球電臺設備草案與 FCC Part 25 對應為主；本來源提供更泛化的 CE RED / ETSI EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 / FCC CFR47 §25 mobile satellite service 視角。
- 與 [[R&S CMW500]] 既有頁相容：既有頁已保存 CMW500 的 NGeCall / LTE capability 與 datasheet；本來源只是簡報層級稱 latest CMW500 SW supports 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling，未提供 software version、license 或 test case ID，不應覆蓋正式 datasheet。
- 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 既有頁相容：既有頁是 Version 13.01 specifications；本來源只是把 SMBV100B列為 EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 測試中的 signal generator solution，不新增產品規格。

passages.text:
R&S TS9982 EMS Test System › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 同列於 Traditional EMC Art 3.1b tests。
- 上下文是 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]] Art 3.1b [[EMC]] requirements。
- 來源指出 Art 3.1b EMC test requirements are not changed by 5G NR。
- EMC tests need both enable radio and disable radio conditions, which means signaling solution for 5G NR。
- Mobile phones require [[Audio Breakthrough]] test, from GSM to VoLTE and VoNR by 5G。
- 來源稱 R&S EMC Systems cover 5G NR functionality, powered by latest [[R&S CMX500]]。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張

NTN protocol signaling › SIB19 中的 SatSwitchWithReSync-r18
- `satSwitchWithReSync-r18` provides parameters for target satellite required to perform satellite switch with resynchronization。
- 該 field 只 present in an NTN cell；其 presence indicates satellite switch without PCI change is supported in the cell。
- `t-ServiceStart-r18` indicates when target satellite starts serving the area currently covered by serving satellite。
- `ssb-TimeOffset-r18` indicates the time offset of target satellite SSB at its uplink time synchronization reference point with respect to source satellite SSB at its uplink time synchronization reference point。
- `ssb-TimeOffset-r18` only included for soft satellite switch with re-synchronization。

R&S TS9975 EMI Test System › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 Market 類簡報中的系統列名；不是 Productions 類 datasheet。
- 不可由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 推論 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 可覆蓋所有 drone standards 或所有 frequency ranges。
- 不可由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 推論 TS9975 可覆蓋所有 CE RED Art 3.1b EMC tests、所有 5G NR bands、所有 [[Audio Breakthrough]] configurations 或所有 mobile phone categories。
- 正式規格、可報價配置、標準 coverage、receiver / chamber / antenna / software / CMX500 option stack 需由產品手冊或 R&S configuration source 補證。

answer.text:
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI, we need formal R&S specifications/features for our products, not sales positioning alone [2][14][20].
We need official competitor documentation or third-party evidence, because current Amarisoft competitor claims are only from an R&S internal battle card [14].
For our signaling side, CMX500 support can be evidenced with formal product positioning and features such as NR FR1/FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, application test, IMS/audio/POLQA, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [6].
For non-signaling or production-side positioning, the Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing source supports CMX500 for R&D signaling/interworking and CMP180 for production non-signaling RF testing [24].
For AI-specific R&S evidence, the only supported AI claim here is that ScriptAssist is an AI-powered script generation tool for NTN-specific R&D protocol/application testing and instrument automation scripting [10].
Any claim that “only R&S,” “safe and future-proof,” or similar superiority language proves a technical advantage should not be used as a verified specification [14].
Any binding technical comparison should use specifications with limits, because the CMX500 features/functions document is an overview and data without tolerance limits is not binding [2].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 相關工具與 package
來源明示或描述下列工具 / package：

- [[Constellation Insight Tool]]：用於 real-time constellation visualization、mobility management、trajectory observation、digital twin of the live sky、automated deployment and handovers、ephemeris data integration 與 complex handover scenarios。
- [[XLAPI]] Python Test Case package：包含 Starlink [[LTE-DTC]] scenarios，例如 LTE attach time / success rates、Event A3 handover、cell reselection 與 RLF recovery。
- [[ScriptAssist]]：AI-powered script generation tool，用於加速 NTN-specific R&D protocol and application testing 以及 instrument automation 的 scripting。
- [[R&S CMX-KS627B]]：[[CMX500_Callbox]] 中列為 NR Signaling Extension Rel-17，用於 NTN slide 的 option 線索。
